name: Testament

searches.publisher: United States Patent and Trademark Office
searches.title: Trademark search
searches.observation: The official search interface loaded and accepted the TESTAMENT wordmark query, but its protected result service did not return a result set to the anonymous research browser.
searches.inference: No conclusion about live or pending United States marks can be drawn from this run.
searches.residual_risk: High. A qualified trademark search covering relevant classes and similar marks remains necessary before a filing, commercial launch, or claim of clearance.

searches.title: npm registry document for testament
searches.observation: The exact unscoped package name testament exists. The registry reports latest version 0.2.0 and describes an unrelated Mocha and RequireJS test server.
searches.inference: Testament cannot publish an unscoped npm package under the exact name without control of the existing package.
searches.residual_risk: Medium. Use an organization scope for any future npm package and avoid implying affiliation with the existing package.

searches.title: PyPI JSON project endpoint for testament
searches.observation: The exact project endpoint returned a Not Found response.
searches.inference: No exact PyPI project was published at the time of access. This is not a reservation.
searches.residual_risk: Medium. Availability can change, and package-name availability is not trademark clearance.

searches.title: crates.io API record for testament
searches.observation: The exact crate endpoint reported that crate testament does not exist.
searches.inference: No exact crates.io crate was published at the time of access. The related git-testament name still exists and the result is not a reservation.
searches.residual_risk: Medium. Recheck before publication and do not treat package availability as legal clearance.

searches.title: GitHub repository metadata
searches.observation: The public jergason/testament repository exists and is unrelated. Factory-AI/testament also exists as the project's public repository. An anonymous global search was rate-limited, so this is not an exhaustive repository-name count.
searches.inference: The repository basename is shared. The qualified Factory-AI/testament name is controlled by this project, but the bare name is not unique in the software ecosystem.
searches.residual_risk: Medium. Always use the qualified organization and repository name where ambiguity matters.

searches.title: RDAP domain record for testament.dev
searches.observation: The registry RDAP response reports testament.dev as registered since 2023 with an expiry in 2027.
searches.inference: The project does not control the obvious .dev domain based on this record.
searches.residual_risk: High. Do not use testament.dev as a schema authority, website claim, or project-controlled identifier unless ownership is separately verified.

searches.title: RDAP domain record for testament.com
searches.observation: The registry RDAP response reports TESTAMENT.COM as registered since 1997 with an expiry in 2027.
searches.inference: The project does not control the obvious .com domain based on this record.
searches.residual_risk: High. Do not imply control, affiliation, or availability.

searches.title: RDAP domain record for testament.org
searches.observation: The registry RDAP response reports testament.org as registered since 1997 with an expiry in 2036.
searches.inference: The project does not control the obvious .org domain based on this record.
searches.residual_risk: High. Public navigation must use a domain that the project has independently verified it controls.

searches.observation: The Datatracker returned no matching active drafts or RFC documents.

searches.query: Exact Testament product and character use
searches.title: Guilty Gear Strive character: Testament
searches.observation: Arc System Works uses Testament as the name of a Guilty Gear character and downloadable game product.
searches.inference: The word has prominent entertainment use outside software infrastructure. The goods and context differ, but search and social ambiguity remain.
searches.residual_risk: Medium. Avoid game imagery, typography, character references, or copy that could suggest affiliation.

review.finding: The record supports continued limited use of the qualified project name, not a claim of trademark clearance. Official trademark searches remain unresolved, exact npm and common domain names collide, and the bare name is not unique.

approval.basis: Public foundation commit 7c468336954921d2bb319bac3f52a7dc46d9ed4c created Factory-AI/testament and established Testament as the chartered project name.
approval.scope: Use of Testament and Factory-AI/testament for this public open-source research repository only.
conditions: Do not describe this record as legal advice, a freedom-to-operate opinion, a trademark registration, or unconditional clearance.
Do not publish an unscoped npm package named testament.
Do not claim or use testament.com, testament.org, or testament.dev as project-controlled domains.
Reopen naming review before commercial launch, trademark filing, domain adoption, or expansion into a new distribution ecosystem.

legal_limitation: This is a documented engineering name search, not legal advice or a trademark opinion. It does not search every jurisdiction, class, common-law use, company registry, app store, social handle, or language.
next_review: Review by 2026-11-21 or earlier if any approval condition is triggered.
